classification: single-factor substitution in the C sleeve of the R344 extended-window portfolio; structural credit-risk proxy

gold_proxy.rule: monthly close > 200-day MA uses gold; otherwise 50/50 treasury+dividend

hypothesis: Replacing the C sleeve generic 15% low-volatility leg with an industry-neutral 15% Merton distance-to-default proxy improves the 2022 weak-market tail and net-of-5x-cost breadth without materially degrading long-window return or drawdown.
limits: The zero-drift one-year proxy is not a full KMV/Merton calibration and does not use a term structure of debt.
PB and debt ratio are PIT financial fields but market equity is inferred through PB rather than a full historical market-value balance sheet.
Financial firms are handled by within-industry neutralization rather than a separate credit model.
Current-snapshot industry classification is backfilled through history.
Membership is reconstructed and ETF qfq is not official PIT total return.
The common window starts in 2022 because TTM financial factors are unavailable earlier.
The 10% C cap, broad C design and gold trend rule were selected in prior post-hoc research.
